task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Redundant clause R2 Existence(door_open) is already implied by the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, at_goal) together with the hard Existence(at_goal), so the machine accepts the same runs without it. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the two Precedence clauses, the hard ExistenceTwo(has_key), and the hard Existence(at_goal).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ExistenceTwo(has_key) hard captures the two-step holding requirement; Precedence(has_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, at_goal) record the stated orders; Existence(at_goal) is the final goal. The chain forces has_key and door_open, and no redundant Existence clauses were added.
